name: deltagraph
description: DeltaGraph by submillisecond.com, as a rune for Claude Code: /deltagraph (draw any diagram as a deltagraph.submillisecond.com URL instead of a mermaid fence - the source travels in the URL fragment, the viewer lays it out and routes it). Installs the hosted deltagraph MCP server (check, debug, url, svg, png, edit, diff, merge, from_code, spec; prompts draw, evolve, tidy), so every diagram is validated through the real engine and looked at before it is handed over. Without MCP, a zero-dep dg-url script encodes a source file into the plain or compressed link offline, and dg-debug reaches the same debugger over plain HTTP, on Windows and POSIX.
